mapper.select: SELECT DATE(timezone('Asia/Shanghai', s.created_at)) AS c0, CAST(COUNT(*) AS bigint) AS c1, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.gross_cents), 0) AS bigint) AS c2, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.platform_cents), 0) AS bigint) AS c3, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.merchant_cents), 0) AS bigint) AS c4, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN s.merchant_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bigint) AS c5, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN s.merchant_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bigint) AS c6, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('WECHAT_FAILED', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bigint) AS c7 FROM order_revenue_split s WHERE s.merchant_id IN #{__item} AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY c0 ORDER BY c0 DESC

SELECT s.settlement_batch_no AS c0, s.merchant_id AS c1, MIN(s.settle_after) AS c2, MAX(s.settled_at) AS c3, CAST(COUNT(*) AS bigint) AS c4, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.gross_cents), 0) AS bigint) AS c5, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.platform_cents), 0) AS bigint) AS c6, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.merchant_cents), 0) AS bigint) AS c7, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN s.merchant_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bigint) AS c8, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN s.merchant_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bigint) AS c9, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('WECHAT_FAILED', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bigint) AS c10 FROM order_revenue_split s WHERE s.merchant_id IN #{__item} AND s.settlement_batch_no IS NOT NULL AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY s.settlement_batch_no, s.merchant_id ORDER BY MIN(s.created_at) DESC
